title: Streamline Your Design: The AI Architecture Review Agent

textBlocks.text: Streamline Your Design: The AI Architecture Review Agent
Accepts plain English, YAML, Markdown, or meeting notes to infer system components.
Leverages Azure OpenAI to identify dependencies and connections within unstructured architectural data.
Generates editable visual maps instead of static images for immediate team collaboration.
Automatically flags single points of failure and security gaps by severity levels.
Scales from zero to five replicas automatically to optimize enterprise cloud costs.
Deploy agents directly into Microsoft 365 environments without writing additional code.

facts.statement: Inputs include plain English, YAML, Markdown and meeting notes.
Structured YAML/Markdown uses a high-speed rule-based parser.
Unstructured text/notes/code uses Azure OpenAI (GPT-4) inference.
Existing diagrams use Excalidraw MCP rendering; this is distinct from inference.
Azure OpenAI identifies dependencies and connections in unstructured architectural data.
Interactive Excalidraw diagrams are editable visual maps for immediate team collaboration.
Risk assessment flags single points of failure and security gaps by severity.
The source illustrates high security risk and medium scalability risk.
Microsoft Foundry deployment scales automatically from zero to five replicas to optimise cloud costs.
Agents publish to Teams and Copilot in Microsoft 365 without additional code.
Risk assessment, deployment and publication are distinct outcomes associated with the architecture model; do not invent a mandatory serial dependency.

interpretationNotes: Frames are approximate normalised reviewer guides; judge the rendered visual hierarchy, not bounding boxes alone.
Three processing bands visually converge on the architecture canvas. The broad white flows and risk dial are explanatory associations, not proof of technical protocols.
The small internal diagram has largely unlabelled geometry. Do not invent component names or infrastructure guarantees.
Source product claims are benchmark content, not independently verified current product documentation.
Text transcription is reviewer ground truth; generators receive the image, not this answer key.
